prompts.name: 01-library
prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high fidelity implementable Windows desktop application screenshot for "LoRA Studio", a Chinese LoRA model manager for ComfyUI. Asset: local library screen, 1600x1000 composition, straight flat full-window screenshot, no device frame, no perspective. Dark charcoal #101113 background, sidebar #161719 width 224px, thin gray borders, restrained warm lime #d7f580 accent, off-white typography, elegant spacious professional creative asset library. Chinese clear typography. Sidebar top simple rounded square layers logo and LoRA Studio, small caption 模型与灵感，井然有序. Navigation 我的模型 selected, 在线发现, 下载中心 with small 2 badge; below 工作空间, 收藏模型, 提示词配方; bottom 设置 and ComfyUI status card green dot 已连接. Main top breadcrumb 工作空间 / 我的模型, top right understated 导入链接 and lime 扫描本地模型 button. Page heading 我的模型, subtitle 为每一次创作，找到恰好的 LoRA. Top right count 128 个模型. Search wide input 搜索模型、标签或触发词, filter 基础模型 全部, sorting 最近添加. Filter chips 全部模型 128, SDXL 64, Flux 38, SD 1.5 26. Four-column cover card grid with 8 cards, cover aspect ratio 4:3, rounded 12px, generous gaps. Covers are tasteful sample art: misty forest, Japanese anime adult portrait fully clothed, brutalist architecture, orange vintage sports car, white porcelain ceramic, snowy mountain, illustrated orange cat, cinematic city at dusk. Each card footer model title English and Chinese e.g. Cinematic Light / 电影质感光影, base model small badge SDXL or Flux, version v1.0, small green installed indicator 已安装, subtle heart outline at top right. Bottom status 128 个模型 · 本地资料已同步. No charts no enormous hero. Exact functional desktop app, cohesive understated typography and premium polish.

Flat straight screenshot 1600x1000 composition no device mockup. Sidebar 在线发现 selected, other same 我的模型 下载中心 收藏模型 提示词配方 设置 and bottom ComfyUI connection. Main breadcrumb civitai.red / 在线发现.
